description:
Base URL, API key and the register / deactivation / test-request endpoints.

The **Company** matters beyond the API calls: it is published to the client on boot, and the COVA block on Job Offer only appears for offers of that company. Pick the wrong one and the pre-employment fields stay hidden everywhere.

Do this one first — nothing else in this list works until it is set.
